A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete 20-page paper, including Appendices A.1–A.5. Text and rendered pages match except for the first-page arXiv version/date stamp; no material comparison gaps remain.

before.justification: v1 reports original layer-vector analyses, safety-layer localization experiments, SPPFT evaluations and ablations, and the parameter-transfer experiment in Appendix A.5.

after.justification: v2 retains the same original empirical results in Sections 3–4 and the appendices, including fine-tuning comparisons and parameter-transfer evaluations.

M1.justification: The cosine-similarity analysis, parameter-scaling and over-rejection localization procedure, and SPPFT freezing of safety-layer parameters are identical in both versions.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same normal and backdoor fine-tuning datasets derived from finance-alpaca, malicious-query and over-rejection evaluations, MMLU, and appendix test scenarios.

E2.justification: Tables 2–3 retain identical comparisons among initial models, SPPFT, and full fine-tuning. The alternative layer-freezing comparisons in Table 4 are also unchanged.

E3.justification: The four tested model configurations, evaluation metrics, 500-example held-out evaluation, prompt processing, and fine-tuning settings in Section 4.2 and Table 6 are unchanged.

E4.justification: Both versions retain the same pretrained-versus-aligned analyses, attention heatmaps, non-safety-layer freezing ablations, scaling-factor sensitivity examples, and Appendix A.5 transfer experiment.

E5.justification: The r=500 random query-pair sampling, mean curves, and shaded fluctuation reporting remain identical. No run-count, seed, uncertainty-estimation, or significance-testing information changes.

E6.justification: The numerical results and qualitative findings in Tables 1–5, Figures 1–7, and Appendix A.5 are identical. No result entries, rankings, or reported trends are added, removed, or corrected.

T1.justification: The vector-set definitions, cosine and angular calculations, residual-layer Equation 1, and associated mathematical reasoning are unchanged. No formal assumptions, propositions, or proofs are added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical claims about discovering and localizing safety layers and using SPPFT to preserve security while maintaining task performance.

C2.justification: The three-stage interpretation of hidden layers, qualification that subsequent layers may still affect security, and scaling-factor failure conditions in Appendix A.2.3 are unchanged.

D1.justification: Prompt templates, scaling-factor selection instructions, Table 6 hyperparameters, evaluator prompts and scoring rubrics, and attention-extraction details are identical. Existing external link targets also match.

R1.justification: Section 2.1, the references, and novelty positioning relative to alignment, over-rejection, and fine-tuning vulnerability research are identical.

P1.justification: Only the first-page marginal stamp changes from arXiv:2408.17003v1 dated 30 Aug 2024 to v2 dated 10 Oct 2024. The paper's prose, terminology, headings, and section structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures, tables, captions, example boxes, and page layout are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. Rendered pages 2–20 are pixel-identical; page 1 differs only in the stamp text.

improvement.justification: v2 preserves the same scientific content, empirical evidence, explanations, reproducibility information, and presentation as v1, including all appendices. Updating the arXiv version/date stamp produces no meaningful difference in overall paper quality.
